name: API
definition: Application Programming Interface - a set of rules and protocols that allows different software applications to communicate with each other

name: REST
definition: Representational State Transfer - an architectural style for designing networked applications using stateless communication and standard HTTP methods

name: HTTP
definition: Hypertext Transfer Protocol - the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web

name: Database
definition: An organized collection of structured data stored electronically in a computer system, typically controlled by a database management system (DBMS)

name: SQL
definition: Structured Query Language - a standard language for storing, manipulating and retrieving data in relational databases

name: JSON
definition: JavaScript Object Notation - a lightweight data-interchange format that is easy for humans to read and write and easy for machines to parse and generate

name: Docker
definition: A platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers - isolated environments that package code and all its dependencies

name: Microservices
definition: An architectural style that structures an application as a collection of loosely coupled, independently deployable services

name: Container
definition: A standard unit of software that packages code and all its dependencies so the application runs quickly and reliably across different computing environments

name: OpenAPI
definition: A specification for building APIs that defines a standard, language-agnostic interface to RESTful APIs

name: CRUD
definition: Create, Read, Update, Delete - the four basic operations of persistent storage

name: Endpoint
definition: A specific URL where an API can be accessed and a specific function can be executed
